verdict.rationale: Data portability is a fair question for a commerce SaaS platform like Square, but the pack documents no first-party export of all account data in open formats. The read APIs (Catalog, Inventory, Locations, List Payouts) and SDKs are developer building blocks a user could assemble into an export, not an export capability itself. "Switch to Square" covers migrating in, not leaving.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
